poker.onboard1: Everyone gets 2 hidden cards. Then 5 shared cards are dealt face-up in the middle: 3 on the flop, 1 on the turn, 1 on the river.
poker.onboard2: Bet on each round — or fold if your hand looks weak. The best 5-card hand at the showdown takes the pot.
poker.onboard3: Blinds are {sb}/{bb} and fixed for practice. There's no real money here — just learn the game!

poker.rules1: Each hand, every player gets 2 hole cards. Betting rounds happen before the flop, after the flop (3 cards), after the turn (4th card) and after the river (5th card).
poker.rules2: On your turn you can fold, check (if nobody bet), call (match the bet), bet/raise, or go all-in. Betting ends when everyone has matched the highest bet or folded.
poker.rules3: If everyone folds, the last player takes the pot without showing cards. Otherwise the best 5-card hand (your 2 + the 5 shared) wins at showdown. Split pots divide evenly.
poker.rules4: Bet and raise amounts are the NEW total bet for the round, not the extra on top. The minimum opening bet is the big blind ({bb}).
poker.rules5: Run out of chips and you're eliminated — rebuy to jump back in. Practice mode only: no real money, ever.
